title: 第五幕 お気に召すまま

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we meet Fuji Kiseki's mother, we learn that, despite being a famous actor, she struggles with stage fright to this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki learns something important from her mother's words. She realizes that what she needs to stand on the turf is the will to keep taking on challenges even if she fails.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gains a new sense of determination. I know in my heart she can overcome anything she sets her mind to.
